doc.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023

title: Political lyrics
summary: She has strong views but has not written political lyrics.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: Have you ever thought about being political in your lyrics?

No. I could, I have strong views, but it just for some reason didn’t seem like a good fit. There are other people who do great political satire and I don’t know, it just didn’t ever come into my head as a compelling thing to do.
Sometimes those kind of lyrics don’t date well either.
It’s like your song now has a short shelf life so to speak.
Yeah who was it who did Haldeman, Ehrlichman, Mitchell and Dean/follows a pattern if you dig what I mean? Who was that?
